status: metadata located; first-100000 existing-production permutation subset selected for source reobservation; no replay run by this manifest author
delta_cos4_definition: cos(4theta_first)-cos(4theta_second), cos(4theta)=(a^4-6*a^2*b^2+b^4)/(a^2+b^2)^2; exact rational from the archived first/second direction labels

selection.requested_subset: First 100000 replica counters of each six-N production-extension/target metadata interval, selected before this source readout is computed
selection.selected_batch_definition: For b=0..99, counters [selected_first+1000*b, selected_first+1000*(b+1)); identical counter blocks for both orientations and every N in a shared-seed dependency group
selection.batch_boundary: These are 100 new analysis batches inside the old production prefix, not the original 100 production batches of 19M or 10M permutations
selection.precision_boundary: New source measurements on an old 100k-per-N production subset; do not claim the original 1.9B/1B production precision or the full original archive source derivative

sampling_semantics.original_measure: Uniform counter-keyed site permutations, with all occupation prefixes implicitly available; Newman-Ziff microcanonical sampling
sampling_semantics.p_ref_reason: No Bernoulli probability is sampled by the original threshold engines; a fixed acquisition p_ref is not defined
sampling_semantics.not_the_P40_rng: Do not use gaussian_orientation_mc.cpp counter_uniform or inherit its N-keyed domain separation for these samples
sampling_semantics.permutation: iota(0..N-1), SplitMixStream(stream_key), descending Fisher-Yates stop=N-1..1 using the source engine's unbiased below(stop+1), including its rejection rule
sampling_semantics.same_N_coupling: Exactly the same label permutation is used for first and second geometry
sampling_semantics.cross_N_coupling: N65,N85,N130,N170 use the same seed and replica keys. Their Fisher-Yates bounds differ but underlying random streams are shared; preserve their joint batch covariance
sampling_semantics.other_groups: N260 and N340 have different seeds from each other and from the four cyclic sizes; separate dependency groups under the usual different-key PRNG assumption

requested_source_statistics.K_range: Every integer K=0..N; each selected permutation contributes once to each K
requested_source_statistics.s: CB_NN(K) + CW_matching(N-K), with black forward and white reverse activation on the same permutation
requested_source_statistics.S: s/N, the same p-independent raw absolute-cluster source as the parent U_dot analysis
requested_source_statistics.bulk_source: s=CB+CW, coupled through one common microscopic fugacity t for every N; Udot_bulk(N)=N*Udot_density(N)
requested_source_statistics.source_extension_comparisons: Report density and bulk derivatives separately. For the explicitly considered constant-microscopic-coupling extensions, apply the original q2/Jordan lineage residuals to Udot_bulk, not to the size-dependent density-source derivative; these are mechanism extension hypotheses, not automatic inherited laws
requested_source_statistics.canonical_transform: For each batch, sum_K binomial(N,K)*p^K*(1-p)^(N-K) times its conditional-on-K mean; analytically differentiate the binomial weights for thermal/source cumulants
requested_source_statistics.root: Solve the pooled first/second mean q=0 separately for each N; refind the pooled root and all source/slope terms inside aligned delete-one replicates
requested_source_statistics.U: N^(13/8)*P4_standard[partial_p mean E]/(2*mean partial_p q), at the size-local pooled root
requested_source_statistics.U_dot: Common raw-source derivative including direct thermal/source, root-motion, source-slope and root-slope terms; not the fixed-p C statistic alone
requested_source_statistics.estimator_boundary: Full-K permutation averages use exact binomial weights. Do not feed their uniform per-K counts into the P40 fixed-p importance-sampling estimator or invent a Bernoulli p_ref
requested_source_statistics.existing_archive_missing: The retained threshold histograms and threshold joint moments contain no cluster-count s, qs or Es profile. Exact deterministic old-counter reobservation is needed; the retained histograms alone are insufficient

cyclic.label_convention: Vertices 0..N-1; positive x step adds a mod N, positive y step adds b mod N; matching also has a+b and a-b steps with lifted displacements (1,1) and (1,-1)

integer_period.period_matrix_convention: Row-major matrix; columns are lifted period vectors
integer_period.label_convention: Column-HNF representatives (rx,ry), label=rx+h11*ry; representative(label)=(label%h11,label/h11); preserve the source QuotientCoordinates reduction and lift
integer_period.source_line_references: QuotientCoordinates:137-221; make_geometry:354; counter_permutation:444; aligned batch loop:760-782
integer_period.incompatible_shortcut: N260/N340 are noncyclic Smith(2,N/2) quotients; do not replace them with cyclic adjacency by the Gaussian a,b labels
